embeddingModels.name: Gemini Embedding 001
embeddingModels.description: Google Gemini embedding model for semantic search and retrieval. Default output is 3072 dimensions (matches API when output dimensionality is not set).
embeddingModels.inputTypeNote: Carries a mode as Google's native task_type, sent per call in providerOptions rather than baked into the model instance. Reached directly there is only one upstream, so unlike the same model through OpenRouter it needs no provider pin. No mode is recommended: this model's DEFAULT output space is already RETRIEVAL_QUERY, so search_query returns the byte-identical vector to sending nothing, and semantic_similarity measured as a LOSS on the one library this has been evaluated against -- last of five sets, against second place for the same model with no mode at all.

chatModels.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
chatModels.description: Cheapest current model, and the replacement for 2.5 Flash Lite — which Google no longer offers to new projects. Generous free tier (500 requests/day). Grounds natively, but a free tier grants the Gemini 3.x family NO search-grounding allowance, so free keys cannot use it for Web Search.

chatModels.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
chatModels.description: Newest stable Flash. Grounds natively on a paid key; a free key gets no grounding allowance for the 3.x family. Note the listed price is promotional through 31 Dec 2026 and doubles on 1 Jan 2027.

chatModels.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
chatModels.description: Latest Flash (Gemini 3.5). Most intelligent Flash for agentic and coding tasks. Grounds natively on a paid key; a free key gets no grounding allowance for the 3.x family.

chatModels.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
chatModels.description: Latest Flash-Lite (Gemini 3.1). Fastest, most budget-friendly multimodal model, with the same generous free tier as 3.5 Flash Lite (500 requests/day). Grounds only on a paid key — the 3.x family gets no free-tier grounding allowance.

chatModels.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
chatModels.description: Legacy (Gemini 1.5). Superseded by Gemini 2.5 / 3.x and slated for retirement. Long 2M-token context.

chatModels.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
chatModels.description: Best free-tier choice for Web Search: the 3.x family gets no grounding allowance on a free key, and 2.5 Flash Lite is closed to new projects. Free tier caps it at 20 requests/day, so a second key from a second project is worth adding.

chatModels.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite
chatModels.description: Fastest, most cost-efficient Gemini model, and grounds on a free key — but Google no longer offers it to new projects, so only an older project can select it. Free tier caps it at 20 requests/day.
